title: 24lb R-404A Refrigerant, Factory Sealed, 100% Virgin – USA Brand
description:
Twenty-four pounds of R-404A from a USA brand, factory sealed and 100 percent virgin. The cylinder has not been opened or decanted since it was filled, which is the practical difference between this listing and the reclaimed R-404A sold alongside it at the same 24-pound size.
Home24Care lists it under commercial refrigerants for professional use, and it is described as compliant with EPA regulations. Twenty-four pounds is the cylinder size the store carries across its R-404A range.
